neighbours.label: the word 'late' in any sense (getting late, too late, arrived late, the late X), plus the cognate token ' tard' (tardy, tardiness); lateness phrased without the word stays quiet
neighbours.notes: Step-out feeder of bonsai1/L7/N11810+ ('too late' idiom). Word, not meaning: 'behind schedule', 'overdue', 'delayed', 'belated', 'missed the bus' stay low in probes. 'late 20th century' period sense is weaker (~0.2). Inverse solver (DE) found no leak; near-miss ceiling ' later' at 0.23. Chat was quiet this mission; sentences are the house's.
fire: It was getting late, so we packed up the tent and drove home.
I'm afraid it is too late to change the booking now.
My flight landed three hours late because of the storm.
Don't be late for dinner, your grandmother is cooking.
The kids stayed up late reading comics under the blanket.
The late senator was remembered for his kindness.
His constant tardiness got him a warning from the manager.
The rent check showed up a week late again.

I'm afraid it is too expensive to change the booking now.
